resurrection.source: GOB 326 has the dead friendly target and approval path. RevitalizeRSI_DirectObject sets health and IS to live maxima and uses Action_Resurrect with the 326 motion context.
resurrection.runtime: AbilityResurrection requires a current matching approval from the downed recipient, then restores their maxima and broadcasts the in-place stand.
resurrection.test: [Native PR820](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/820#issuecomment-7086365203) sent 326 from the stock client, paid 100 IS, cast for 4 s and started 45 s reuse. QAFriend stayed down until consent, then set HP/IS 777/333 and stood in place using motion 63. The native client displayed the caster's Revitalize RSI message.

script.source: RevitalizeRSI_DirectObject restores the recipient, plays Restore RSI, sends both messages and retains the conditional PvP path.
script.runtime: AbilityResurrection restores vitals and publishes sender/recipient feedback and the source-specific motion. The recipient's PvP choice is preserved.
script.test: CallbacksRestoreScriptResourcesAndPreserveTheActualPvpChoice covers both flag states. The disposable ability-resurrection-resources replay observes the owner and observer motions and the one-use approval. [Stock PR820](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/820#issuecomment-7086365203) verifies the complete unflagged path.

resurrection.source: GOB 375 uses the dead friendly target and approval path. ReviveRSI_DirectObject restores live HP and IS maxima and uses Action_Resurrect with the 375 motion context.
resurrection.runtime: AbilityResurrection requires a new matching approval for 375 from the current downed recipient, then restores their maxima and broadcasts the in-place stand.
resurrection.test: [Native PR820](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/820#issuecomment-7086365203) sent 375 after a separate death, paid 100 IS, cast for 6 s and started 30 s reuse. Approval restored HP/IS 777/333 and motion 63 in place. The native client displayed the caster's Revive RSI message.

script.source: ReviveRSI_DirectObject restores HP and IS, plays Restore RSI, sends both messages and retains the conditional PvP path.
script.runtime: AbilityResurrection publishes the correct motion and feedback for 375 and preserves the recipient's PvP choice.
script.test: CallbacksRestoreScriptResourcesAndPreserveTheActualPvpChoice covers both flag states. Ability-resurrection-resources confirms the 375 owner/observer motion and rejects repeat Yes. [Stock PR820](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/820#issuecomment-7086365203) verifies the unflagged path.
